tailscale.layout: An optional bar widget (kind bar-widget, defaultSection right). The Tailscale service installer enables it, and bar defaults place it in the right section immediately after the tray. The bar glyph is the TailscaleIcon, a native 3x3 dot grid at the bar icon size (12). The top row and the two bottom corners are at opacity 0.24; the middle row and the bottom-centre dot are at 1.0. The icon uses the bar foreground when active, else Qt.darker(fg, 1.55). It is crossed by a -45 degree bar when off, and carries a red "!" badge when login is needed. Left click toggles the panel, right click toggles Tailscale, and middle click refreshes. The panel is a KeyboardPanel, 380 wide, with height fitted to content capped at 560. Its content is a vertically flickable Column with 12px spacing. Top to bottom: (1) a PanelHero titled with this machine's name (else "Tailscale"), with a TailscaleIcon at display 24. Its meta is a rotating phrase when active (every 2.8s, 150ms fade out and 200ms fade in), else "Tailscale is disconnected". The icon is at opacity 0.5 when off. A ToggleSwitch sits on the trailing edge, with tooltip "Turn Tailscale off", "Turn Tailscale on" or "Authorize this device". (2) A status or error line in bodySmall 11, dim, or urgent for errors. (3) When the CLI is missing, a row "Tailscale CLI is not installed or not on PATH." in body 12, dim. (4) When there is more than one account, or access is denied: a PanelSeparator, then the CONNECTIONS section header with 10px spacing. It holds an AuthRow (U+F0483 at heading 16, dim; "Authorize Tailscale operator" in body 12 over "Allow this user to operate this Tailscale profile" in caption 10, dim) and one AccountRow per account. Each AccountRow is a U+EB01 glyph in a 22px column, then the label in body 12, bold when selected. The current account gets selected fill, and the glyph pulses while switching. (5) When active with exit nodes or Mullvad: a separator and EXIT NODES, rows 6px apart. Each row has a 22px glyph column: U+F11E2 for a tailnet node, U+F0582 for Mullvad, "+" for "Choose Mullvad region". The name is in body 12, bold when this is the active exit node. Tooltip Connect or Disconnect; the glyph spins (900ms) while setting. "+" opens an inline picker: a TextField "Search regions", then region rows (U+F0582, city in body 12 over country in caption 10, dim) or "No Mullvad regions found.". (6) When installed and active: a separator, then a header "MACHINES · N" ("MACHINES · n OF N" while filtering). A TextField "Search machines  ( / )" appears when there are more than 8 peers. dropbox.layout: An optional bar widget (kind bar-widget, defaultSection right). The Dropbox service installer enables it, and bar defaults place it in the right section two slots after the tray, after Tailscale. The bar glyph is DropboxIcon: five filled diamond tiles drawn as Shapes, 1.18:1 wide, at height bar icon size / 1.18 (about 10.2, 12 wide). It uses the bar foreground when authenticated and syncing, else Qt.darker(fg, 1.55), at opacity 0.6 while paused. Left click toggles the panel, right click refreshes, and middle click starts the login. The panel is a KeyboardPanel, 380 wide, with height fitted to content capped at 560, scrolling in a Flickable Column with 12px spacing. Not authenticated: only the status line and a login row show. The login row is a U+E707 glyph at heading 16, then "Login to Dropbox" in body 12 over "Start the authentication flow" in caption 10, dim. If the CLI is missing, those read "Dropbox CLI is not installed" and "Install Dropbox from the service menu". A PanelActionButton U+F030B sits on the trailing edge, with no tooltip. Authenticated, top to bottom: (1) a PanelHero titled "Dropbox" with a DropboxIcon at display 24 (28.3 wide, artwork scale 0.95). Its meta is a rotating phrase every 2.8s while syncing, else "Syncing paused". A trailing ToggleSwitch has tooltip "Pause syncing" or "Resume syncing". (2) The status/error line in bodySmall 11, dim, or urgent for errors. (3) A "Stored" row: the label in bodySmall at opacity 0.6 on the left, and the value on the right, e.g. "12.3 GB of 2 TB" (decimal units), or the used amount alone when the quota is unknown. (4) A PanelSeparator. (5) The RECENT FILES section header, then up to 25 FileRows 6px apart. Each row has margins of 10 and an 8px gap: a file-kind glyph at icon 14, then the file name in body 12 over "5m ago · folder" in caption 10, dim. Each row is content + 12 tall. Clicking a row opens Nautilus with the file selected. If there are no files, "No synced files found." appears in body 12, dim, centred.

notes: Container: the KeyboardPanel's header comment says the bar strip is masked out of the overlay (KeyboardPanel.qml:34-37,148-152), but the mask covers the whole screen (KeyboardPanel.qml:164-167). Bar clicks are caught by the overlay and forwarded to the widget under the pointer (KeyboardPanel.qml:404-458). While a panel is open the bar gets no hover, so bar tooltips cannot appear. That is inferred from the full-screen overlay sitting on the Overlay layer above the bar; it was not observed.

Container: no stock panel uses PopupCard. All eleven panel widgets use KeyboardPanel, a full-screen Overlay layer with the card drawn inside it. PopupCard (an xdg-popup) is used only by the tray's two menus and the media widget. The two differ in scale origin (icon point vs card top-centre), in dismissal (overlay MouseArea vs HyprlandFocusGrab) and in morph support (KeyboardPanel only).

Container: the card can be clamped against the right screen edge, so it is not always centred under its icon. At 1440px every 380px panel from network rightward pins to x = 1055, and only the scale origin tracks the icon. An agents panel at slot 1270..1297 wants x = 1093.5, which is also clamped.

Runtime: card height is the content's implicitHeight, which depends on font line metrics (JetBrains Mono at 12px is about 16px per line). Each section notes its estimated row heights. They are approximations, not source values.
Runtime: with Hyprland animations off (omarchy toggle animations), Style.duration returns 0 and every panel transition in this file is instant (shell/Commons/Style.qml:363-367,484).

Runtime: popups.border becomes a gradient when the theme's colors.toml defines hyprland_active_border. Tokyo Night does not, so the border is flat accent #7aa2f7 (default/themed/shell.toml.tpl:23,130).

Shared controls: PanelActionButton's comment says 22x22, but the code makes it 23x23 (| 1 forces an odd size). The ToggleSwitch is square-cornered at rounding 0. The PanelSlider knob is always round, whatever the rounding.

Bar foreground in panels: most panels draw with root.bar.foreground (Color.bar.text, the theme foreground by default) rather than Commons.Color.foreground or popups.text. Under the 'none' bar background mode, Bar.foreground stays themeForeground while barForeground follows the wallpaper (shell/plugins/bar/Bar.qml:82-86). Panels therefore keep the theme colour.

Merged sections: clock, weather, audio, power, network, bluetooth, monitor, agents, elsewhen, indicators, tray, keyboardLayout, systemUpdate and media were researched per panel; wifiqr, speedtest, diskSpeedtest, tailscale and dropbox are optional and not in the default bar. Every citation was checked to point at an existing file and line range. Expression tokens were fuzzy-matched against the cited lines: 905 of 909 matched, and the 4 misses are prose expressions.

[clock/weather] Both panels colour their text with bar.foreground (Commons.Color.bar.text, which falls back to foreground) and use bar.fontFamily. They do not use popups.text (shell/plugins/panels/clock/Panel.qml:86-87; shell/plugins/panels/weather/Panel.qml:593-594; shell/plugins/bar/Bar.qml:79-85; shell/Commons/Color.qml:81,86). The two are equal unless a theme sets bar.text or popups.text.

[clock/weather] Hover and selected colours resolve through tokens that default to "foreground" (Style.qml:72-75). So hoverStateColor and selectedStateColor are plain foreground at the defaults, and hover tints in these panels change nothing at stock settings except the 0.08 fills.

[clock/weather] Text heights depend on runtime font metrics, so total heights are approximate. Estimates use JetBrainsMono line height ≈1.32×px: hero row ≈69px at 52px, year rail ≈15px, nav label ≈16px, giving a clock content height of ≈69+8+21+8+256+8+26 = 396px before the KeyboardPanel inset. Not verified against a render.

[clock/weather] Clock default week start: shell.json sets no weekStartDay, and the English formatLocale is en-US (default/i18n/locales.json:5; shell/Commons/I18n.qml:25), whose Qt firstDayOfWeek is Sunday. So a stock English install shows a Sunday-first grid. That Qt en_US firstDayOfWeek is Sunday comes from Qt/CLDR, not from this repo.
[clock/weather] Clock week numbers are ISO weeks of each row's Thursday, even with a Sunday start (Model.js:270-277).

[clock/weather] The clock panel has no selected day, no agenda and no events; the comment says the grid is 'a read-out rather than a picker' (Panel.qml:12-14). Day cells have no MouseArea and no hover state.
[clock/weather] The clock hero shows today's date, not the viewed month. It is clickable (goToToday, tooltip 'Back to today') only while another month is shown.

[clock/weather] The 'Memento Mori' tooltip is a hard-coded literal, not translated (clock Panel.qml:557). The life rail is hidden until someone double-clicks the year rail and enters a birth year. Settings keys: birthYear, lifeExpectancy, weekStartDay (written to the omarchy.clock shell.json entry).

[clock/weather] Clock bar 'alt format' is not a click toggle: right-click walks a ring of 10 presets and persists the choice to shell.json. formatAlt only adds an entry to the ring when it is not already a preset (default 'd MMMM 'W'ww yyyy' already is one).
[clock/weather] The clock bar tooltip is always 'Right-click to toggle format', with no date or time in it.

[clock/weather] Weather manifest names settingsForm 'weatherSettings', but no definition of that form exists anywhere in the repo at this commit (grep finds only the manifest). Settings read by the panel: unit ('', 'imperial', 'metric') and refreshMinutes (default 15).

[clock/weather] Weather has no error string in the panel. On failure the last good data stays. With no data at all, the hero shows '—' (U+2014) for glyph and temperature and 'Fetching forecast…' appears below. The bar widget stays hidden until the first glyph arrives.

[clock/weather] Nerd Font names for weather glyphs (U+E30D etc., from the Weather Icons set) are not given in the source and are left out here. The only source comment naming a glyph is U+F041 'nf-fa-map_marker'. Calendar glyph U+F00ED and chevrons U+F0141/U+F0142 are Material Design Icons codepoints (calendar, chevron-left, chevron-right), named from knowledge, not the source. U+F0996 (saving spinner) is not named in the source.

[clock/weather] Forecast-day glyphs never use night variants. Patchy-rain, patchy-snow and sleet glyphs (U+E308/E333, U+E30A/E327, U+E3AD) occur only through the wttr fallback: open-meteo codes never map to them (Model.js:257-268).

[clock/weather] The current-condition source is open-meteo when coordinates are known (configured or geo-detected), otherwise wttr current_condition (Panel.qml:146). Units use the system Qt.locale().name, not the Omarchy language, while day names use I18n.formatLocale.

[clock/weather] Weather's typical content height is unresolved: it depends on the 64px glyph and 56px number line heights, and on whether the hero's right column (location ≈16 + 12 + stats ≈ 15+5+19) is taller than the left. A rough estimate is ≈160px.

[clock/weather] Clicking the weather bar widget calls Panel.toggle(), which opens via openFromHotkey(). Mouse opens therefore also suppress the bar's centre hover reveal; the separate open() path (openedFromHotkey=false) is unreachable from the bar widget (BarWidget.qml:22-24; Panel.qml:55-58).

[audio/power] Text line heights (hero ~34px audio / ~37px power, device rows ~28px, stream rows ~52px, typical audio content ~410px) are estimates from JetBrainsMono Nerd Font metrics at the given pixel sizes. Control heights (PanelSlider 22, ToggleSwitch 54x34, separator 1, battery bar 8) are exact from source.
[audio/power] Audio's per-app mixer section is headed 'SOURCES' (key audio.sources), not 'Apps' or 'Streams'. No app icons are drawn: a stream row is mute glyph + name + percent over a slider.

[audio/power] The audio panel's default-device marker is not a checkmark: the default row gets the selected fill (foreground alpha 0.18) and a bold label. Headphones and HDMI are told apart only by glyph (U+F02CB / U+F0379), never by extra wording. Their label is whatever PipeWire's node.nick/description says after friendlyDeviceLabel strips it.

[audio/power] The bar/hero speaker glyph uses Font Awesome codepoints (U+F026/F027/F028, U+EEE8 for muted or 0%), while stream rows use Material Design ones (U+F057E/U+F075F). The source comment says this matches the old Waybar set. With headphones as the default sink the glyph is always U+F02CB, even when muted: the hero dims to 0.5 but the bar glyph does not change.
[audio/power] Output volume is clamped to 0-100% everywhere (slider, keys, bar wheel). Per-app stream sliders go to 150%.

[audio/power] The output slider, percent and status read the 'volume sink' that omarchy-audio-output-sink resolves through DSP sinks (speaker tuning, EasyEffects) to the physical output. The default-device marker and the headphone check use the default sink itself (Panel.qml:141-200).
[audio/power] inputIcon() (Panel.qml:488-491, U+F036D muted / U+F036C live) and moveSection() (Panel.qml:317-326) are defined but never used in the audio panel.
[audio/power] Scrolling on the audio bar widget summons the omarchy.osd overlay with {icon: outputIcon(volume), value: round(volume*100)} (Panel.qml:507-513). The OSD's look is outside this scope.
[audio/power] Neither bar widget has a tooltip at this commit: audio leaves tooltipText at its empty default, and power sets it to "".

[audio/power] Power: systemInfo is read every 5s from omarchy-system-stats (Panel.qml:230-234) but nothing in the panel renders it. This panel has no brightness, lock, suspend, reboot or shutdown controls.

[audio/power] Power: the hero percent and stats come from the omarchy-battery-status --shell script (integer percent). The bar label, glyph, progress bar and state logic come from UPower.displayDevice, so the two can briefly disagree.

[audio/power] Power stats use three different placeholders: U+2014 em dash for missing cycles/time/percent, ASCII '-' for 'not applicable' (full or held), and an empty string for missing battery size.

[audio/power] Power phraseIndex is not reset on open, so the first phrase shown is wherever the rotation last stopped. On first open it is index 0: 'PUMPING POWER' when charging, 'SLURPING POWER' on battery.

[audio/power] Power status edge cases: on AC at 100% without UPower's FullyCharged state, charging is false (batteryFlowIdle) and the status falls back to modeLabel 'FULLY CHARGED'. When a charge threshold holds, it reads 'THRESHOLD' and the stats switch to 'Charge limit' and 'Battery state: Holding'.
[audio/power] The power panel's active profile comes from omarchy-powerprofiles-list --active-state, not from the battery service's activePowerProfile (Service.qml:20), which feeds other consumers.

[audio/power] Microphone bar widget (shell/plugins/bar/widgets/Microphone.qml, not in the default bar at config/omarchy/shell.json:50-67): U+F036C live / U+F036D muted, highlighted as active while an app records. Tooltip 'Microphone muted' / 'Microphone in use' / 'Microphone live'. Left or right click toggles mic mute, middle click opens the audio panel, wheel +-5% (Microphone.qml:54-74; default/i18n/en/shell.json:148-150).

[audio/power] The default bar order puts omarchy.audio before omarchy.monitor, with omarchy.power last (config/omarchy/shell.json:59-67). Tab in either panel switches panels via bar.switchPanelFrom, whose order is outside this scope.

[network] There is no ethernet row list, no VPN, no airplane-mode toggle and no Wi-Fi on/off empty-state string. Ethernet appears only in the hero ('Ethernet (1gbit)') and the details grid. The hero ToggleSwitch is the only radio control.

[network] No explicit empty state for the network list. With Wi-Fi off, or nothing in range, the separator stays and the list is 0px tall with no message.
